programme.title: Rip Off
programme.desc: The team must track down two gangs of robbers, one of which has an informant in its ranks who is tipping off the rival one.

programme.title: Skin Trade
programme.desc: Caitlin is undercover as a madam to stop a pornography and sex-slavery ring; Nash calls Caitlin by his ex-wife's name.

programme.title: Liar's Poker
programme.desc: Nash is undercover as a favor to an FBI agent; Inger and Lucia return from Sweden; Nick's poker buddies get him in trouble.

programme.title: El Diablo
programme.desc: While Nash investigates the death of a woman who plunged off a balcony, Joe gives Evan a second chance to redeem himself.

programme.title: Hit and Run
programme.desc: Nash and Joe's client is killed when the building in which they are meeting explodes; Joe's mother-in-law and Nick fall in love.

programme.title: Cop Out
programme.desc: Nash must catch a man who dons a police uniform and terrorizes people; Nash and Caitlin must learn to get along during work; Nick wants his driver's license.

programme.title: Line of Sight
programme.desc: A drug dealer tries to corner the market by killing his competition; Evan and Cassidy discover they are being stalked when they begin dating again.

programme.title: Heist
programme.desc: Nash must infiltrate a thief's base of operation in order to catch him; Joe protects a mean-spirited restaurant critic; Evan returns to the unit; Caitlin may become Nash's boss.

programme.title: Hard Cell
programme.desc: Nash must help a convict in exchange for valuable information; Joe has a hard time with a delivery boy.

programme.title: Missing Key
programme.desc: Joe is the target for murder when a woman plants a key with him; Nick performs in Cassidy's play; Harvey is involved with a complicated woman.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: A police chief is murdered, and Jake Cage (Steve Austin) returns to assist Nash in the investigation.

programme.title: Jackpot
programme.desc: Nash is undercover in Las Vegas to stop an Asian kingpin; Evan is shot in the line of duty; Cassidy goes to the police academy.

programme.title: Rock and a Hard Place
programme.desc: Soon after Nash's daughter, Cassidy, joins the Special Investigation Unit, an escaped felon convicted with tainted evidence kidnaps her and Joe.

programme.title: Jump Start
programme.desc: Nash flips when he finds out that Cassidy played a hooker to nab a South African diamond smuggler; a new investigator joins the force.

programme.title: Lap Dance
programme.desc: Nash gets more than just a favor from a former lover when trying to take down a criminal with stolen cruise-missile secrets.

programme.title: Land Pirates
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are hot on the trail of a clever ring of thieves that preys on San Francisco's elite; Nash discovers the secret behind a nun's double life.

programme.title: ManHunt
programme.desc: A drug gang knocks over a DEA evidence warehouse and proves elusive for the members of the team; Antwon has a seizure while chasing down the leader of the gang.

programme.title: Double Trouble
programme.desc: Nash and Joe (Don Johnson, Cheech Marin) find out that someone has been "borrowing" the name of their detective agency. Guest stars: Jenna Lewis, Joel Klug, Sean Kenniff and Gervase Peterson of "Survivor."

programme.title: End Game
programme.desc: Nash and the others uncover a deadly game wherein the players try to assassinate each other; Nash's friend Boz Bishop is framed for murder.

programme.title: Blow Out
programme.desc: Nash and Joe track down former SIU officer Rick Bettina, who escaped during his parole hearing to recover the money he stole.

programme.title: The Messenger
programme.desc: Nash protects a newscaster from a deranged fan; Joe is caught in the middle of a crime while selling his car.

programme.title: Grave Robbers
programme.desc: Nash takes on the case of a clever con man who fakes his own death after ripping off a dangerous organized crime boss; Joe learns that his mother-in-law smokes marijuana.

programme.title: Bear Trap
programme.desc: Nash and Joe bear down on black market poachers selling animal gall bladders; the office buzzes with rumors of a romance between Nash and Rachel.

programme.title: Recover Me
programme.desc: A wealthy accounting adviser sets Rachel up for a murder, and her lack of cooperation confuses Nash until he discovers a secret from her past.

programme.title: Something Borrowed
programme.desc: Nash is flabbergasted to learn that he's legally married to Tamara Van Zant and comes to the conclusion that she's up to her old tricks again; Nick acts as a "beard" for a lesbian friend.

programme.title: Out of Miami
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Rick Hawks comes back to the Bay Area to transport a key witness in an important drug trafficking case.

programme.title: Slam Dunk!
programme.desc: Nash and Joe investigate the murder of a wealthy lawyer; Cassidy and Rachel are caught in a love triangle.

programme.title: The Partner
programme.desc: Nash and the SIU team try to stop a vigilante who is killing the criminals that are under investigation.

programme.title: Blood Bots
programme.desc: Nash tracks the ringleader of a new technical gang who built a small army of remote-controlled robots, fully equipped with heavy artillery, to pull off a string of robberies.

programme.title: Quack Fever
programme.desc: Painful memories and the dangers of the drug trade collide when Nick learns the truth about Nash's older brother Bobby, who was supposedly missing for more than 20 years.

programme.title: Kill Joy
programme.desc: The murder of a newscaster begins a string of stalkings involving women of the same name, and Harvey eventually discovers the killer's motive.

programme.title: Change Up
programme.desc: Cassidy's future in law enforcement comes under question when her and Rachel's attempts to stop a bank robbery can't prevent an executive's death.

programme.title: Cat Fight
programme.desc: Nash turns up a handful of surprises when tracking down two young women responsible for the death of a security guard during a robbery at a rock concert.

programme.title: Fair Game
programme.desc: While questioning her career in law enforcement, Cassidy steps into the wrong taxi at the wrong time when she becomes a killer cabby's fare; Rachel learns that Nash is being set up.

programme.title: Genesis
programme.desc: A San Francisco police investigator (Don Johnson) uses keen instincts, wit and charm on the job but has less success in his personal life.

programme.title: Home Invasion
programme.desc: A gang terrorizes Nash's (Don Johnson) ex-wife (Serena Scott Thomas) and daughter (Jodi Lyn O'Keefe); Joe (Cheech Marin) moves in.

programme.title: Skirt Chasers
programme.desc: A heroin dealer sets up shop in San Francisco, but his penchant for buying time with women gives Nash and his team a shot at taking him down.

programme.title: High Impact
programme.desc: Nash and Joe Dominguez try to protect the mayor when a religious fanatic takes fire and brimstone seriously and detonates bombs all over San Francisco.

programme.title: The Javelin Catcher
programme.desc: A deadly military weapon stolen by gang members leads Nash to work with a military adviser before more gang violence erupts.

programme.title: Vanishing Act
programme.desc: When a sting operation falls apart and Harvey Leek disappears with the government's money, Joe and Nash set out to prove his innocence.

programme.title: Aloha, Nash
programme.desc: Nash puts his romantic vacation with Kelly on hold to pursue the evils behind an incriminating betting book; Ian's girlfriend is taken hostage.

programme.title: Key Witness
programme.desc: Nash sets out to help Lisa, whose eyewitness account of a murder raises some eyebrows when no body can be found; Joe checks out his new investment.

programme.title: Internal Affairs
programme.desc: Nash must clear his name after being suspended following an Internal Affairs accusation that he murdered a suspect in revenge.

programme.title: Till Death Do Us Part
programme.desc: Joe is exposed to a deadly virus after a thief unwittingly releases it into the air while foraging for drugs at a chemical lab.

programme.title: The Great Escape
programme.desc: Nash's daughter, Cassidy, is kidnapped by an escaped anti-government extremist who is out to avenge his imprisonment and separation from his family.

programme.title: Wrecking Crew
programme.desc: Nash and Joe are taken hostage while attempting to nab a gang of professional thieves during a robbery.

programme.title: Trackdown
programme.desc: Nash attempts to apprehend a former best friend who has become an international mercenary sent to San Francisco for a hit.

programme.title: The Brothers McMillan
programme.desc: Dead bodies begin surfacing as two brothers vie for control of the Irish mafia in San Francisco; Joe suspects someone is stealing from his bar.

programme.title: Night Train
programme.desc: Nash and his team take the subway home from a bachelor party and are held hostage after walking into the midst of a robbery.

programme.title: Zodiac
programme.desc: Nash calls on his former mentor, Dale Cutter, for help in a murder case that has all the signs of the infamous Zodiac killings.

programme.title: Leo's Big Score
programme.desc: Nash baby-sits a juvenile felon marked for death by drug dealers; Joe gives his son J.J. a job at the bar.

programme.title: Hit Parade
programme.desc: A money launderer-turned-informant is killed, and Nash and Joe discover they are next in line unless they can find the hit man first.

programme.title: Promised Land
programme.desc: A student accused of attempted murder leads Nash and Joe to a Chinese slavery ring smuggling illegal immigrants into the country.

programme.title: 25 Hours of Christmas
programme.desc: Christmas is put on hold as Nash and Joe investigate the death of a store executive murdered at the site of a professional jewelry heist.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 200

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 201
programme.desc: Caroline and Ridge meet at the office and sparks fly. In the year end meeting Ridge argues with Eric and Thorne over business tactics.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 202
programme.desc: Beth accuses Brooke and Storm of speaking to Eric but they deny it. Beth meets Eric for dinner and is embarrassed to find he knows about the biopsy.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 203
programme.desc: Beth tells the family she will have the biopsy and that Eric gave her the strength to do it. Kristen accuses Clarke of dating her to get his designs to Eric but he disagrees.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 204
programme.desc: Ridge tells Stephanie that he thinks she set Eric up by getting pregnant and she slaps him. She explains that they were in love and she will fight for their marriage now.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 205
programme.desc: Katie tells Rocco about Donna's modeling job and he goes to find her. Donna is being pressured into sex with a customer and Rocco rescues her.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 206
programme.desc: Stephanie tells Eric about Beth's biopsy and he is surprised at how sympathetic she is. Donna gives Storm the money from her modeling job to cover Beth's bills.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 207
programme.desc: Ridge talks Margo into helping him with his marketing idea and they connect. Caroline turns down Bill's job offer because he is too protective.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 208
programme.desc: Clarke visits Stephanie and tells her he loves her. Ridge asks Rocco to help him start a new project and Rocco says yes.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 209
programme.desc: Eric is worried about Beth but tries to act surprised when Stephanie tells him about Beth's mastectomy.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 210
programme.desc: Beth asks her doctor about reconstructive surgery. Kristen tells Stephanie she is having problems with Clarke and asks for advice.

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 211

programme.title: The Bold And The Beautiful: Episode 213

programme.desc: After leaving Dodge City, Bat Masterson takes a job as manager of Denver's Palace Theatre. There he falls in love with Emma Walter, a jugging virtuoso known as the Queen of Clubs, and begins to question his life as a gunslinger.

programme.title: Lonesome Dove: Part II - On The Trail
programme.desc: McCrae and Wood's cattle drive faces deadly situations. Sheriff July Johnson heads to Texas, and former prostitute Lorena is abandoned by Jake and kidnapped by the psychotic Blue Duck.

programme.title: Our Friend, Chaos
programme.desc: An explosion rips through the downstairs of Beth-H, changing lives there forever.

programme.title: Agatha Christie's Hjerson (Dubbed) S1 E5: Episode 5
programme.desc: An unpublished novel inspires a copycat murder at a restaurant. Only five people, including the author, have read the work- so it must be an inside job. Or is it? The author contacts Hjerson and Klara to crack the case.

programme.title: Don't Take My Heart, Don't Break My Heart
programme.desc: When The Herald uncovers a sex scandal, Holly makes a powerful enemy.

programme.title: The Founders
programme.desc: As the streets become a battlefield, Macy faces impossible split-second choices that could mean life or death for herself and her allies.

programme.title: You Have to Remember
programme.desc: Unexpected alliances form while old loyalties collapse. As friends become enemies, Macy struggles to know whom she can trust amid mounting casualties.

programme.title: We Gone See
programme.desc: Caught in the crossfire of a gang war reaching its peak, Macy fights to protect her loved ones while confronting the devastating consequences of her choices.

programme.title: Aurora
programme.desc: Mitchell narrowly escapes death at the hands of a pair of vengeful archangels, one of whom he may have loved in the past, while Khan and Smith maneuver their pawns into place, in anticipation of a final showdown.

programme.title: The Juror #6 Job
programme.desc: When Parker attends jury duty in order to keep up the legitimacy of one of her aliases, she notices some strange things at the trial. It seems someone is trying to buy a favorable verdict... but not if the Leverage team can steal it first!

programme.title: Wife love, mother love, a hint of wind
programme.desc: Soshun Kouchiyama, a tea master at Edo Castle, secretly fights injustice by beating up powerful oppressors, with the help of his friends.

programme.title: Beware of Falling Rocks
programme.desc: Cameron and Boris begin to question Lucy's mysterious past. Their suspicion grows when they learn Lucy must attend an exclusive meeting at Condon Aerospace, so the two decide to sneak into the event to investigate matters further.

programme.title: Tunnels
programme.desc: Cameron wants to enter a skateboarding competition at Crater skate park but soon finds out that he is grounded and must clean his father's studio. Upon doing so, Cameron discovers a way to sneak out to the skate park after all.

programme.title: The Secret Society
programme.desc: Concerned about Cameron's behavior, the school sends him to a psychologist. When Boris visits the psychologist in Cameron's place, he reveals a little too much information, and they soon realize that this is no ordinary psychologist.

programme.title: The Cavern
programme.desc: A violent storm traps Conan in a cave with Hissah Zul's hit man.

programme.title: Season 1, Conan The Adventurer 121: Lethal Wizards
programme.desc: Three wizards, Penor, Gero and Norbu, decide to join the Cimmerian so they can be Conans advisors when he becomes the new ruler. Their plan is to worm their way into Conans confidence, then destroy him and take over as rulers.

programme.title: Redbad - The Legend Part 3
programme.desc: During a time of epic battles and bloodshed, the legend of pagan warrior king Redbad is born, but so is a new weapon against his people: Christianity.

programme.title: Day Of Reckoning
programme.desc: Matsou and his wife Hatoya nurse Ben back to health after he gets injured in a fight. However, a bigoted farmer takes action when Ben gives them a piece of land as a thank you.

programme.title: Press Conference
programme.desc: GHF and The Wonderland's joint press conference for their tour doesn't go to plan once AJ gets involved but Nate is distracted by his relationship-status with Chloe.

programme.title: Quiet After The Storm
programme.desc: A girl is shot by her jealous boyfriend and a lynch mob is after him.

programme.title: Cracks
programme.desc: A judge dies, Leon arrives, and the class-action case goes to trial.

programme.title: The Long Road To Nowhere
programme.desc: After a novelist is killed by an unknown entity, Mike Hammer agrees to investigate the murder. However, plot twists lead to more questions, and Hammer learns there's more to the story.

programme.title: Disaster Strike Force: Quake
programme.desc: The team responds to the threat of a potentially devastating earthquake in Los Angeles.

programme.title: Disaster Strike Force: Mega Quake
programme.desc: The entire California coastline is threatened as a 20.0 earthquake looms.

programme.title: Big Mama
programme.desc: As the group struggles with the disappearance of one of its own, they accept sanctuary in a town run by its Sheriff and his troops. Meanwhile, Dmitri inches closer to achieving his darkest goal.

programme.title: The Final Act (Part 1)
programme.desc: Helen Mirren stars as DS Jane Tennison, a seasoned detective plunged into the alien world of teen girls after a 14-year-old goes missing.

programme.title: 51st State
programme.desc: The 51st State is the story of Elmo McElroy (Samuel L. Jackson), a streetwise American master chemist, who heads to England to set up his last big deal -- to introduce a new designer drug to the European market. McElroy soon becomes embroiled in a web of double-dealing as he's escorted around Liverpool's underworld and rave scene by rabid local hood Felix De Souza (Robert Carlyle), who hates all things American.

programme.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
programme.desc: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: The Gunman [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Eight years after fleeing the Congo following his assassination of that country's minister of mining, former assassin Jim Terrier (Sean Penn) is back, suffering from PTSD and digging wells to atone for his violent past. After an attempt is made on his life, Terrier flies to London to find out who wants him dead -- and why. Terrier's search leads him to a reunion with Annie (Jasmine Trinca), a woman he once loved, who is now married to an oily businessman (Javier Bardem) with dealings in Africa.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: The Devil's Arithmetic
programme.desc: Hannah Stern (Kirsten Dunst), an American-born Jewish adolescent, is uninterested in the culture, faith and customs of her relatives; however, Hannah begins to reevaluate her heritage when she has a supernatural experience that transports her back to a Nazi death camp in 1941. There, she meets a young girl named Rivkah (Brittany Murphy), a fellow captive in the camp. As Rivkah and Hannah struggle to survive in the face of daily atrocities, they form an unbreakable bond.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Straight A's
programme.desc: Compelled by his mother's ghost, a former addict (Ryan Phillippe, "Crash") returns home to face his first love (Anna Paquin, "The Piano"), who happens to be his brother's wife.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Jack's Back [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a sickening coincidence -- or a sinister homage to actual crimes -- women are being murdered in Los Angeles 100 years after Jack the Ripper terrorized London. Police think John Westford, a young doctor, is the murderer, and when he's found hanging from a noose, authorities believe his apparent suicide is a tacit admission of guilt. But his twin brother, Rick (also Spader), insists John was killed, and, when it appears Rick is right, the investigation takes a stunning turn.

programme.title: Mysteria
programme.desc: Fighting to finish his script for a producer (Billy Zane), screenwriter Aleister (Robert Miano) finds inspiration amid a murder investigation led by Captain McCarthy (Michael Rooker) and his interrogator (Danny Glover).

programme.title: The Getaway (1994) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Doc and Carol McCoy are married criminals looking for a high-paying score. When Doc ends up in a Mexican prison, Carol tells mob boss Jack Benyon that Doc will work for him if Benyon can free him from prison. Benyon hires Doc to rob a dog track, but after the heist goes terribly wrong, Doc and Carol escape with the cash. With a bitter thief and Benyon's hired help on their trail, Doc and Carol must fight to survive.

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: The Contract
programme.desc: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Mercenary for Justice
programme.desc: As a mercenary, John Seeger (Steven Seagal) has a reputation that precedes him. That's why he's being blackmailed into performing a risky job: breaking the son of a wealthy arms dealer out of a South African prison. With his friends taken hostage, Seeger agrees to do the deed -- but finds out too late that he's been double-crossed. Not one who likes being taken for a fool, Seeger hatches an elaborate plan to get even that will make the prison break look like capture the flag.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Grizzly Rampage
programme.desc: A rogue bear turns a camping trip deadly, forcing five friends to flee through the forest with a ranger.

programme.title: Encounter with the Deadly Iron Lizard
programme.desc: The warden of an African prison is holding Fujiko captive. Lupin and his gang infiltrate the prison and attempt to break Fujiko out, but they become the target of the Iron Lizards.

programme.title: The Case of the Eminent Family's Strange Deaths (Part 2)
programme.desc: Hideomi Nagato's body is found at the bottom of the pond in the Nagatos' backyard. It is speculated to be suicide but Conan thinks otherwise.

programme.desc: Conan, Ran and Sonoko find themselves in the middle of a bank robbery while running errands at the local bank.

programme.desc: Conan runs into a wandering stranger with amnesia and recognizes him as a famous artist; his body is later found under an overpass.

programme.desc: In order to save the kidnapped singers, Conan dresses up as Ayumi and delivers the new song to the perpetrators.

programme.title: The General Hospital Murder Case
programme.desc: Kogoro is stuck in the hospital after an injury but witnesses a murder outside the window. He immediately calls the police but nobody answers!

programme.title: The Ski Lodge Murder Case (Part 1)
programme.desc: Conan, Ran and Sonoko see their elementary school teacher Yonehara on a ski trip and are invited to the villa where Yonehara and her friends are staying.

programme.title: Public Disturbance

Gerald wants a Public Broadcast Radio affiliate in Greenville so bad that he and Helen host a pledge drive and Gerald surprisingly raises all $100,000 needed, from an old woman named Ruth.

programme.title: Where Did the Cinderella Stamp Go?
programme.desc: According to legend, a stamp named the Cinderella Shadow is said to make its owner a princess. Lupin and his gang pull off the heist, but a girl named Alice who also wants the stamp tags along.

programme.title: Female Detective Melon
programme.desc: Lupin has sent a notice declaring he will steal all the cash from every bank in Paris. Detective Melon, the granddaughter of Inspector Garimard, is chosen to catch Lupin alongside Inspector Zenigata.

programme.title: Electric Pigeon Tactics
programme.desc: Lupin has many secret techniques, and one of them is levitation. In order to get their hands on this technique, a crime syndicate plots a dirty trick.

programme.desc: As Heiji reveals the culprit, Shinichi shows up to the scene claiming Heiji's deduction is incorrect and solves the case.

programme.title: The Library Murder Case
programme.desc: Conan and the Detective Boys suspect a librarian is hiding more than just books in shelves.

programme.title: The Golf Range Murder Case
programme.desc: A relaxing day of golf leads Conan, Kogoro and Ran to their next explosive case with Eisuke Tachibana, the president of a company.

programme.title: The Case of the Mysterious Murder Weapon
programme.desc: Conan, Ran and Kogoro find a wounded bird and then hear a scream from a nearby building; they find Ryusuke Imoto on his balcony supposedly murdered by a potted plant.

programme.desc: Exploring how and why premodern cities implemented public health measures before the plague.

programme.title: Laughter and Joy: Boccaccio's Decameron
programme.desc: Discovering how the writer Giovanni Boccaccio found humor and joy in life, even amid suffering.

programme.title: A Meeting of Two Worlds
programme.desc: Introducing the themes of increasing American power; indigenous political aspirations; conflicting interests and goals; growing mutual antagonism; setting the stage for World War I.

programme.title: Wilson & the Breakup of the Ottoman Empire
programme.desc: An examination of wartime and postwar American policy; showing how Wilson's commitment to an ethnocentrically defined view of national self-determination drives his efforts to shape the postwar settlement in the Middle East.

programme.title: The Interwar Period
programme.desc: American interest in the Middle East between the wars; revealing one's focus shifting in the 1930s to American interest in Saudi Arabian oil; the increasing activism of American Zionism in response to Hitler's persecution of German Jews.

programme.title: U.S. & the Middle East During World War II
programme.desc: United States' entry into World War II alters Americans' conception of the Middle East; the Middle East's geopolitical orientation is now seen as vital to American security.

programme.title: Creation Stories and Why They Matter
programme.desc: The nature of creation stories.

programme.title: Reading Metaphor in Creation Stories
programme.desc: Metaphor and symbol are integral to creation stories, as they form a crucial part of the language of myth.

programme.title: Mesopotamian Creation: Enuma elish
programme.desc: Enuma Elish, also called the Seven Tablets of Creation, is a masterpiece of Mesopotamian literature.

programme.title: The Mesopotamian Flood: The Atrahasis Epic
programme.desc: Examining key Mesopotamian texts referencing a catastrophic flood which decimates humanity.

programme.title: Muslim Empires: Land, Language, Religion
programme.desc: The geographical region known as Greater Middle East; the range of nations and cultures that define it; historical turning points to witness, encompassing conquests, political alliances and Islam's rise; social, intellectual and economic reforms.

programme.title: Muhammad and the Dawn of Islam - 622
programme.desc: Islam's rise is a major turning point; tracing key phases in the life of Muhammad (PBUH); the founding of the faith through his years of opposition; his establishment of Islam as a religious and political entity; the global impact of these events.

programme.title: Arab Invasion of North Africa - 639
programme.desc: The seventh-century Arab invasion of North Africa brings profound change to the entire region; the Arab armies of the newly created Islamic empire try to conquer the territories of Egypt and others; the lasting Arabization and Islamization.

programme.title: Umayyad Caliphate in Damascus - 661
programme.desc: The establishment of the Umayyad Caliphate's capital in Damascus is a key event in early Muslim history; the Umayyads' achievements; locating the empire's capital away from the Arabian Peninsula; the shift from an Islamic empire to imperial power.

programme.title: Bearing Off: The Story of Backgammon
programme.desc: During the Third Crusade, the European soldiers spend the winter playing the ancient game of Tables, which would evolve into backgammon by the 20th century.

programme.title: Senet: Egypt's Game of the Afterlife
programme.desc: Unearthed artifacts from King Tutankhamun's tomb include Senet boards. Historians study the hieroglyphs and investigate the abrupt disappearance of this ancient Egyptian game.

programme.title: Chess: The Evolution of a Strategy Icon
programme.desc: Developed during the Guptas' rule in India, Chaturanga is a strategy game resembling chess. It gradually wended its way westward to become what it is in the present.

programme.title: Chess's Eastern Cousins: Shogi and Xiangqi
programme.desc: The East Asian games of Xiangqi and Shogi are potentially connected to Chaturanga and chess, but a lack of documentation makes it difficult to ascertain anything.

programme.title: American Presidents and the Rule of Law
programme.desc: Exploring the roots of the presidency and presidential power as outlined in the Constitution; the advantages and disadvantages a president has during an investigation; why presidential investigations are essential knowledge for any American citizen.

programme.title: Presidential Investigations through History
programme.desc: Presidential crises and abuses of power; early executive scandals and their significant long-term effects; how people are still dealing with the fallout of famous investigations; the controversies of Ulysses S. Grant and Warren G. Harding.

programme.title: Separation of Powers and the Presidency
programme.desc: Legislative and judicial oversight of the presidency as a permanent part of the American government; limiting and restraining the possibility of executive abuse; how a system of checks and balances came to exist; the case of Marbury v. Madison.

programme.title: Watergate and the Special Prosecutor
programme.desc: The Watergate burglars and how the consequences of their arrest brought down President Richard Nixon; two important Supreme Court cases that shaped a president's power to dismiss personnel; the Independent Counsel Act.

programme.title: Rise and Fall of the Independent Counsel
programme.desc: Why Congress and the public were convinced that an independent investigator was essential; the swing from the Nixon era to the independent counsel of the Reagan and Clinton eras; the special counsel investigating Russian election hacking.

programme.title: Significance and Historical Context
programme.desc: The major players in the debate over the Constitution's ratification; those who take part in the struggle in New York, where thoughtful Anti-Federalist writings are produced; later responded to with Federalist papers organized by Alexander Hamilton.

programme.title: Classical Republicanism
programme.desc: The Anti-Federalists attack the proposed constitutional order; saying it departs too much from the Greco-Roman ideal of virtuous participatory republicanism; the Anti-Federalist objections; their own reservations about classical republicanism.

programme.title: The Anti-Federalists' Republican Vision
programme.desc: The participatory and virtue-centered vision of the Anti-Federalists dictates a more decentralized arrangement than the more consolidated national government proposed by the Federalists; the Federalists' focus on the demands of national security.

programme.title: The Argument over National Security
programme.desc: A need for sound defense and foreign policy; The Federalist critiques the existing constitution; a critique of the inadequacy of confederacies. Anti-Federalists counter by suggesting that Federalists may be falling prey to visions of an empire.

programme.title: The Deep Difficulties in Each Position
programme.desc: Anti-Federalists accuse Federalists of giving national security pre-eminence over republican freedom; Federalists reply by claiming that Anti-Federalists fail to face up to what union and national security truly require.

programme.title: Debating the Meaning of "Federalism"
programme.desc: The Federalists' defense of Federalism reveals that the state governments are to be strictly subordinate to the central government; thereby intensifying the Anti-Federalist critique.

programme.title: Ordinary Lives in Revolutionary Times
programme.desc: A first look at the roles common people played in the revolution and its impact on them.

programme.title: Down and Out in Colonial America
programme.desc: An assessment of the reality of urban poverty in colonial America in the 1760s.

programme.title: Jane Mecom: Franklin's Struggling Sister
programme.desc: The experience of Jane Mecom, the sister of Benjamin Franklin.

programme.title: Boycotting the Townshend Taxes
programme.desc: A broad look at commerce in the pre-revolution American colonies.

programme.title: Ebenezer Mackintosh: Stamp Act Protestor
programme.desc: The story of Mackintosh, a shoemaker who led mass protests against the British.

programme.desc: Reeling from their brutal encounter with Strahd, the party must decide Zora's fate, receive magical items forged from their worst regrets, and face an unexpected offer that could change everything as they close in on the third banshee.

programme.title: Ravenloft - Ep 8: Lord Soth
programme.desc: This is it! The epic finale to Campaign 1 of Dungeon Masters. Lord Soth's wrath has shattered the realm, and our heroes must beat the un-beatable, escape the inescapable, and find their way home before everything they love is swallowed by the dark.

programme.title: King's Crystal
programme.desc: A glassware factory in Midsomer Magna faces ruin after the death of its co-owner Alan King. His widow Hilary angers her son Ian by marrying Alan's brother Charles, and rumours begin to circulate that Charles and accountant Peter Baxter have embezzled funds. When Peter is stabbed to death with a Masonic dagger and Ian starts behaving strangely, Barnaby is called.

programme.title: The Axeman Cometh
programme.desc: When old rock band Hired Gun re-form to play a gig at the Midsomer Rocks Festival, paranoid lead singer Gary Cooper is convinced that someone is trying to scare them off and stop the reunion. Firstly, rock diva Mimi Clifton is electrocuted on stage, then drummer Nicky Harding is found dead in his swimming pool. Barnaby has to face the possibility that one of his heroes is a murderer.

programme.title: Death and Dust
programme.desc: When Dr Alan Delaney is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby realises that the real target was Delaney's senior partner, Dr James Kirkwood. Is the killer trying to prevent James from marrying beautiful divorcee Delyth Mostyn? How is the death linked to the £30,000 which is missing from the surgery account?

programme.title: A Picture of Innocence
programme.desc: When a photo of DCI Barnaby with another woman is displayed shortly before her estranged husband is murdered, he becomes a prime suspect in the crime. To make matters worse, it appears that Barnaby visited the victim on the night he died, and a glass with his fingerprints on it is found at the dead man's home. As the evidence begins to mount up against him, will Barnaby be able to clear his name?

programme.title: They Seek Him Here
programme.desc: When Nick Cheyney, director of a new film of 'The Scarlet Pimpernel' is beheaded by a guillotine on set, there is no shortage of suspects. An actor whose career he has ruined, a woman who bore his child after a drunken one-night stand, and an embittered gay, alcoholic extra all have grudges against him. Medical evidence then shows that Cheyney was drugged with morphine. Can Barnaby and Jones find the killer?

programme.title: Death in a Chocolate Box
programme.desc: When an old colleague of DCI Barnaby's is found murdered, a sex scandal at Causton police station 16 years previously comes back to haunt him. His investigation takes him to Midsomer Holm, a halfway house for ex-prisoners founded by Lord Holm, a man who also served time for the murder of his wife. As they try to find links between the suspects and a seedy group known as the Friday Nighters, another person goes missing.

programme.title: The Dogleg Murders
programme.desc: The peaceful setting of prestigious Whiteoaks Golf Club is rocked by death and controversy when a golfer is bludgeoned to death near the notorious 13th hole known as Crisp's Folly. Barnaby and Jones discover gambling is rife at the club - along with illegal money-lending and violent assault. Then, as the club considers giving ordinary villagers full membership rights, another golfer is killed.

programme.title: The Black Book
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby finds a tangled world of crime and intrigue in the art world. A recently discovered masterpiece by local artist Henry Hodgson realises an impressive price at auction just hours before its previous owner is tortured and killed. Can Barnaby and Jones prevent the body count from rising further?

programme.title: Secrets and Spies
programme.desc: DCI Barnaby's secret past as a spy is revealed when a former agent is found dead after a cricket match in Midsomer Parva. While locals blame the brutal killing on the 'beast of Midsomer', Barnaby suspects otherwise. He soon finds links to a network of spies that operated in Cold War Berlin, but his investigation is obstructed at every turn.

programme.title: The Glitch
programme.desc: Science fellow George Jeffers threatens to go public with what he believes is a potentially lethal software glitch in a new air traffic control system. American software boss Clinton Finn fears he will lose millions if the truth comes out and puts pressure on the University authorities, but when village schoolteacher Emily Harte is killed by a hit-and-run driver, Barnaby wonders if Jeffers was the real target.

programme.title: Small Mercies
programme.desc: The peace of Little Worthy is shattered by a bizarre murder when a man is found stabbed and tied down like Gulliver in Lilliput in the sleepy hamlet's model village. Barnaby and Jones are called in, and they find many secrets hidden behind the traditions, tourist attractions and tearooms. Then, the killer strikes again. Can the detectives discover the truth about the residents of Little Worthy and solve the crimes?

programme.title: The Creeper
programme.desc: A burglar known as 'the Creeper' terrorises Midsomer as Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder of a dinner party guest at upper-crust Chettham Park House. The detectives discover a group of high society friends with links both to gangsters and the Chief Constable dating back to the 1960s, but do the friends also have secrets worth killing for?

programme.title: The Great and the Good
programme.desc: Schoolteacher Connie Bishop keeps waking in the night, convinced she has an intruder. Just days later a local councillor, said to be obsessed with her, is found murdered in her garden. Is Connie the innocent victim she seems? Barnaby and Jones uncover jealous rivals, ruthless social climbers and a cottage with secrets as they search for the killer in Badger's Drift.

programme.title: The Dagger Club
programme.desc: The crime drama returns for a new series. The unveiling of a newly-discovered novel by deceased Midsomer crime-writer George Summersbee at the Luxton Deeping Crime Festival is jeopardised when the manuscript is stolen and a woman is fatally electrocuted by a booby-trapped roulette wheel. Can new dad Barnaby untangle a web of jealousy and obsession to find the killer?

programme.title: Murder by Magic
programme.desc: When a pub landlady is crushed to death during a magic show in Midsomer Oaks, Barnaby and Nelson uncover conflict between the village church and ancient pagan traditions. Is famous magician Gideon Latimer to blame or is he the target?

programme.title: The Ballad of Midsomer County
programme.desc: Barnaby investigates whether a ballad made famous by a late, lamented folk singer could have been the inspiration for a murder. Did someone want to kill Toby Winning for threatening to take the Little Crosby Folk Festival away from Midsomer - or is the true motive something hidden for 20 years?

programme.title: A Vintage Murder
programme.desc: Barnaby tries to find out just who is targeting the Midsomer Vinae Winery - what does the attack have to do with the death of a child in a hit-and-run accident?

programme.title: Death in the Slow Lane
programme.desc: New DCI John Barnaby is intrigued when he learns that the remains of famous racing driver Duncan Palmer have been discovered at Darnley Park School - 40 years after he was thought to have drowned in the Lake District. During the school's classic car show, racing legend Peter Fossett is annoyed that his fellow judge is club DJ Dave 'Doggy' Day, who knows nothing about cars. Soon afterwards, Doggy is crushed to death.

programme.title: Dark Secrets
programme.desc: A social services investigator calls on elderly eccentrics William and Mary Bingham, but he is sent away rudely by their daughter Selina and her husband Eddie Stanton. Artist Maggie Viviani also had a run-in with the investigator, so when his body is found in the river, they all come under suspicion. Barnaby learns that the Binghams never recovered from losing their elder daughter and son in a drowning accident.

programme.title: Echoes of the Dead
programme.desc: When a young woman is found dressed like a bride and drowned in a bath, it triggers a spate of ghoulish wedding-themed murders in Great Worthy. The case takes Barnaby and Jones to a donkey sanctuary, a heritage steam railway and a pub run by an ex-copper and former brothel madam. Could history be repeating itself?

programme.title: The Oblong Murders
programme.desc: When a young female member of a new age cult called The Oblong Foundation goes missing, DCI John Barnaby investigates and sends DS Jones undercover at the cult's base, Malham Hall. The police learn that the hall's previous owners, the Lamberts, died in a gas explosion on board their boat. Barnaby and Jones must try to find out what really happened to the Lamberts - and whether the case has a link to the missing woman.

programme.title: The Sleeper Under the Hill
programme.desc: When a farmer is found horribly murdered in the middle of a stone circle, suspicion points at a group of druids. DCI John Barnaby and DS Jones hurry to the scene of the crime, where they are joined by new pathologist Kate Wilding on her first assignment. Druid high priest Leticia Clifford shows Barnaby that sacred ley lines run through the stone circle and later is convinced she has made an exciting discovery.

programme.title: The Night of the Stag
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones are sampling the local cider at Midsomer Abbas spring fair when the body of a missing tax inspector is found floating in the cider vat. Meanwhile, publican Samuel Quested says that he wants to restore an ancient rite called the Stag in which men go in search of women from another village in order to 'refresh the gene pool'. As Barnaby and Jones investigate the murder they uncover an array of motives.

programme.title: A Sacred Trust
programme.desc: Barnaby and Jones enter the cloistered and old-fashioned world of Midsomer Priory after a nun is found strangled. Jones visits the local pub, where he learns that a woman was seen acting strangely on the day of the murder, and that teenagers in the area sneak into the priory grounds for romantic liaisons. Later, the nuns discover that a valuable silver altar set has vanished, then the chaplain is found murdered.

programme.title: A Rare Bird
programme.desc: A row between keen birdwatchers in Midsomer-in-the-Marsh turns nasty when their president is killed. Patrick Morgan met his death while hoping to sight a rare bird, but is his obsession with ornithology to blame - or something more sinister? Barnaby and Jones attempt to discover the truth.

programme.title: Dead Man's Eleven
programme.desc: When the wife of a wealthy landowner is bludgeoned to death with a cricket bat, DCI Tom Barnaby and his team are enmeshed in a succession of calculating murders. Once again, blackmail, deceit, greed and revenge threaten to destroy Midsomer's tranquillity.

programme.title: Blue Herrings
programme.desc: When the dead body of Muriel Harrap is found late one night at the Lawnside residential home, everyone assumes she died of natural causes. It is not until another seemingly healthy resident dies and rumours of fraud and deception emerge that Alice Bly feels the compulsion to ask her favourite nephew, DCI Tom Barnaby, to investigate.

programme.title: Judgement Day
programme.desc: The locals fear their chances of winning the Perfect Village competition have been dashed when a petty thief is stabbed to death with a pitchfork. Things spiral out of control when two of the competition judges are also murdered, leaving DI Tom Barnaby to track down the killer before he strikes again.

programme.title: Blurring the Color Line
programme.desc: Blurring the Color Line follows director Crystal Kwok as she unpacks the history behind her grandmother's family, who were neighborhood grocery store owners in the Black community of Augusta, Georgia during the Jim Crow era.

programme.desc: Summoned to a bloodthirsty vampire's faraway castle, a young land clerk embarks on a harrowing journey into the unknown as his innocent wife falls under the spell of a terrifying shadow in her dreams.

programme.title: How to Eat Your Watermelon in White Company (and Enjoy It)
programme.desc: Melvin Van Peebles was one of the first black directors to challenge the white establishment in his films, which include "Watermelon Man" and "Sweet Sweetback's Baadasssss Song." In this documentary, the life of Van Peebles is discussed, including his work not only in film, but also as a novelist, actor, musician, stock trader and even Air Force pilot. Interview subjects include Gil Scott-Heron, Spike Lee and Melvin's son and fellow filmmaker, Mario Van Peebles.

programme.title: Dirty Dilemma
programme.desc: In today's ever-changing dating landscape, can anyone truly claim to have a pure connection devoid of lies, secrets, and trust issues? For Malika and Kyrie, their love will be pushed to the brink as they face the ultimate test.

programme.title: Decade of Fire
programme.desc: In the 1970s, fires consumed the South Bronx. Black and Puerto Rican residents were blamed, even as they fought to save their homes. Vivian Vázquez Irizarry pursues the truth around the fires, uncovering racist policies and neglect that shape our cities.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: Insert Coin
programme.desc: The untold story of how Mortal Kombat, NBA Jam, and other arcade classics were created by a ragtag crew in the back of a Chicago factory. Generating billions of dollars, they rode the wave of the booming 90s arcade scene... until a new enemy appears.

programme.title: Nothing in Los Angeles
programme.desc: Quinn is a writer dating Ann, a woman twice his age. His best friend Peter is married to Beth but having a bit of a sexual identity crisis. When a connection sparks between Quinn and Beth, it makes all four reevaluate what love means to them.

programme.title: The Cran

programme.title: Calla Lily
programme.desc: An experimental drama, Melanie, who was drugged and raped in college. Now ten years later, she is in an abusive relationship and has a child. A chance encounter with someone from her past leads her to re-evaluate her past.

programme.desc: In the aftermath of 9/11, a South Asian teen struggles to make sense of his brother's murder while developing a relationship with a girl from his neighbourhood.

Matt wrote an article about it, and overnight, it went viral in China, where internet users identified the man as "Brother Orange." Matt became an instant celebrity, and as media followed their every move, he and Brother Orange formed a deep friendship that transcended cultural and language barriers.

programme.title: Part 1

programme.title: Downfall [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1942, young Traudl Junge (Alexandra Maria Lara) lands her dream job -- secretary to Adolf Hitler (Bruno Ganz) at the peak of his power. Three years later, Hitler's empire is now his underground bunker. The real-life Traudl narrates Hitler's final days as he rages against imagined betrayers and barks orders to phantom armies, while his mistress, Eva Braun (Juliane Köhler), clucks over his emotional distance, and other infamous Nazis prepare for the end.

programme.title: Season Of The Witch
programme.desc: His faith broken by many years fighting in the Crusades, a knight named Behman returns to Europe and finds it ravaged by the Black Plague. A dying cardinal orders Behman and his friend, Felson, to take an accused witch to a remote abbey, where monks will destroy her powers and end the pestilence. As Behman and five comrades undertake the dangerous journey, they come to realize that the prisoner is no ordinary girl, and evil forces await at the destination.

programme.title: Brotherhood Of The Wolf [English-Language Version] [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a rural province of France, a mysterious creature is laying waste to the countryside, savagely killing scores of women and children. Unseen, possessed of enormous strength and a human intelligence, the beast has eluded capture for years. King Louis sends in a renowned scientist and his Iroquois blood brother, an unconventional team whose combined methods and capabilities may bring the beast down. But the true nature of the beast is not what anyone could have anticipated.

programme.title: Donnie Darko (Director's Cut) [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In a funny, moving and distinctly mind-bending journey through suburban America, one extraordinary but disenchanted teenager is about to take Time's Arrow for a ride. After surviving a freak accident, Donnie (Jake Gyllenhaal) begins to explore what it means to be alive, and in short order to be in love, he uncovers secrets of the universe that give him a tempting power to alter time and destiny.

programme.title: Crawdaddy
programme.desc: Amid the pandemic, Gwynn grows bored with her relationship with Adam. A sex dream involving their friend Lance ignites fantasies, transforming her COVID bubble into a chaotic love triangle.

programme.title: Guardians
programme.desc: During the Cold War a secret organization created an elite squad of superheroes to defend the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Just Getting Started
programme.desc: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him.

programme.title: The Ron Clark Story
programme.desc: In his small North Carolina hometown, Ron Clark (Matthew Perry) leads a comfortable life as a successful elementary school teacher, earning the respect of the community. However, he knows there are students elsewhere who need him more. Following his inner calling, Clark uproots to New York City, hoping to make a difference for the disenfranchised youths the school system has left behind. Clark makes it his mission to turn around the worst students, even though he knows his job is on the line.

programme.title: Journey to the End of the Night
programme.desc: Sinatra and his adult son, Paul, live on the edge of the law in the Brazilian urban jungle of São Paulo. They make a meager living running a brothel, but what profits they make Paul gambles away. When a customer dies on their premises, leaving behind a suitcase brimming with drugs, Sinatra sees a way to start a new life for his new wife and her young child. But his scheme quickly gets complicated when Paul sees the opportunity to take a calculated risk.

programme.title: Judy Moody And The Not Bummer Summer
programme.desc: Judy (Jordana Beatty) has planned the most awesome summer ever and can't wait to have adventures with her best friends, Rocky and Amy. Then she finds out that Rocky is off to tame lions and that Amy is flying to Borneo with her mother to save a lost tribe. Judy is bummed to be left home with her rotten brother, Stink (Parris Mosteller), and her second-best friend, Frank Pearl. And, what's worse, her parents go to California and leave her with an aunt (Heather Graham) she's never even met.

programme.title: The Last Unicorn
programme.desc: In this animated musical, the villainous King Haggard (Christopher Lee) plots to destroy all the world's unicorns. When a young unicorn (Mia Farrow) learns that she's in danger and that she may soon be the last of her kind, she leaves the safety of her protected forest and enlists the help of Schmendrick (Alan Arkin), a gentle, albeit clumsy, sorcerer. Together, they embark on a long and dangerous journey with one goal: to defeat Haggard and save the unicorns from extinction.

programme.title: Georgia Rule [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Teenage Rachel (Lindsay Lohan) is a real thorn in the side of her mother, Lilly (Felicity Huffman). More than just rebellious, she is incorrigible. After Rachel crashes a car, Lilly decides to haul the girl off to a place to which she vowed never to return: Her own mother's (Jane Fonda) Idaho home. Georgia, the family matriarch, lives by a strict code and expects all under her roof to do the same. Given structure and purpose, Rachel's anger at the world begins to subside.

programme.title: Part 1

programme.title: Monty Python And The Holy Grail
programme.desc: Grossing the highest box-office of any British film in the US when released in 1975, this "cult classic" comedy from the Monty Python team loosely follows the legend of King Arthur (Graham Chapman), along with his squire (Terry Gilliam) and his Knights of the Round Table (John Cleese, Eric Idle, Terry Jones and Michael Palin), as they embark on a fearless quest in search of the elusive Holy Grail. A hysterical, historical tour-de-force from Terry Gilliam and Terry Jones.
